2.88.16
Chart.ChartNoDataMessage
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Chart.ChartNoDataMessage element specifies the message to display if a Chart contains no
data. This element is optional. This element is of type ChartTitle.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.ChartNoDataMessage element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ChartNoDataMessage element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartNoDataMessage" type="ChartTitleType" minOccurs="0" />
